name: tr_cmb
caption:
IF COLLIN HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🐣 Torchic: a little chick with a fire burning inside. South Carolina Gamecock to pick 9
🔥 Ho-Oh: its Regenerator ability heals it when it switches out. Mono couldn't stop him
🎨 Smeargle: its signature move Sketch copies any move. 17 points, 15 rebounds, 3 blocks, 3 steals, a first in our history
🪲 Heracross: flings foes away no matter how heavy. Playoff career-high 22 points as we beat Cleveland
🐆 Liepard: sneaks up and strikes before you can react. 4 steals at Milwaukee
🐻 Ursaring: would rather snap a tree than climb it. Our bruiser, 10.7 points a night in his first 9 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Collin Murray-Boyles had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF COLLIN HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Torchic. A little chick with a fire burning inside. A South Carolina Gamecock, and we took him ninth.
beats.dlg: A CHICK WITH FIRE INSIDE.|SOUTH CAROLINA TO PICK 9!

beats.vo: Ho-Oh. Its ability, Regenerator, heals it every time it switches out. Mono knocked Collin out in college. He came right back.
beats.dlg: REGENERATOR: IT HEALS UP.|MONO COULDN'T STOP HIM!

beats.vo: Smeargle. Its signature move, Sketch, copies any move it sees. Seventeen points, fifteen boards, three blocks, three steals. A first in our history.
beats.dlg: SKETCH: COPIES ANY MOVE.|17-15-3-3, A TEAM FIRST!

beats.vo: Heracross. No matter how heavy the opponent, it flings it away with its horn. Twenty-two points as we beat Cleveland in the playoffs.
beats.dlg: FLINGS ANY FOE, ANY SIZE.|22 AS WE BEAT CLEVELAND!

beats.vo: Liepard. It sneaks up from behind and strikes before you can react. Four steals at Milwaukee this month.
beats.dlg: STRIKES BEFORE YOU REACT.|4 STEALS AT MILWAUKEE!

beats.vo: And the ace. Ursaring. It would rather snap a tree than climb it. Our bruiser: ten point seven a night in his first nine games.
beats.dlg: SNAPS STOUT TREES.|10.7 A NIGHT IN 9 GAMES!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Murray-Boyles played college basketball for the South Carolina Gamecocks; before the 2023-24 season he contracted mononucleosis and missed significant time, then became a top player upon returning; chosen ninth overall (#9, pick 9) by Toronto in 2025; January 11, 2026: 17 points, 15 rebounds, 3 blocks and 3 steals, the first player in Raptors history with those numbers; April 23, 2026: playoff career-high 22 points in a 126-104 win over Cleveland
